# Step 2.119: the game format at the table

## Builder 1 (below the screens)

What exists:

- **Migration 0026** (`supabase/migrations/0026_game_given_format.sql`): `games.given_format`, the format a game was GIVEN, apart from `format` (FIXED at the start). A trigger refuses a change once the game has started. The plan said no migration; one was needed (T-340).
- **Contracts** (`packages/contracts/src/season-rules.ts`): `GameFormatRules` (version, gameFormat, clock, fouls, timeouts: checklist B1, same checks as a season), `formatOfRules`, `rulesWithFormat`, `parseGameFormat`, `gameFormatPresets` (high-school, rec-league, season: B2), `formatFacts` and `FORMAT_FACTS` (every rule, the clock mode included: S-39).
- **Core** (`packages/core/src/modules/games`): commands `giveGameFormat` (`games.give_game_format`, input `{gameId, version, format}`), `clearGameFormat` (`games.clear_game_format`, `{gameId, version}`), read `readGameFormat` (`games.read_game_format`, `{gameId}` → `GameFormatView`: version, given, season, applies, source fixed/given/season, facts, change `{may, as}` or `{may: false, reason: no-permission | setting-off | under-way}`, presets). The rule is in `game-format.ts`; refusal codes are the same three plus `game-not-found`, `changed-since-read`, and `not-allowed` from the command layer. `effectiveRulesOf` and mark not started now use `rulesBeforeStartOf` (given, else season's), so the tracker's batches and the reset follow a given format.
- **Setting** `games.scorekeepersMayChangeFormat` (yes/no, league, on), declared in `leagues/settings/declarations.ts`, label in `messages/en/admin-settings.ts`. Activity words for both commands in `messages/en/activity.ts`.
- **Database**: `findGameGivenFormat`, `updateGameGivenFormat`, wired in `games-store.ts`; the web stand-in (`stand-in-world-games.ts`) has both too.
- **Tests**: `give-`, `clear-`, `read-game-format.test.ts` (halves to quarters at the table, clock, periods and bonus on the server; other game untouched; setting off refuses a scorekeeper, allows an admin; under way refuses both; 8-minute quarters survive start and mark not started; no permission; stale version), `contracts/src/game-format.test.ts`, `database/src/schema/game-given-format.test.ts` (0026), isolation cases `isolation/game-format-cases.test-helper.ts`.
- **Decisions** pending: T-340 to T-343, and S-93 (decided for you, not built: step 2.241). Spec corrected: P7 §5.2 (mark not started), T3 `games`.

Run and passed: `npm run typecheck`, `npm run check`, vitest of `packages/core/src/modules/games`, `leagues`, `packages/contracts` (98 files, 888 tests), the 0026 schema test, `tests/pending-decisions.test.mjs`.
